explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/91: 'In [Er87b] Erdős says that there are at least two non-similar examples for 6 ≤ n ≤ 9' of n-point planar sets minimising the number of distinct distances. The Lean variant ¬ UniqueMinimizer 9 says there exist two optimal 9-point sets (|A| = 9 and distinctDistances A = minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 9) that are not related by a dilation equivalence ℝ² ≃ᵈ ℝ² (bijections scaling all distances by a fixed factor, i.e. similarities of the Euclidean plane). This is exactly the n = 9 case of Erdős's claim. Faithful.
